sourceTitle: The AI Bubble Survives on Hidden Debt
title: The AI Boom Is Running On Debt, Not Profit
hook: The AI boom is running on debt, not profit.
question: Bubble or not?

scenes.narration: The technology is genuinely real. But here is the uncomfortable part. A lot of the AI boom is running on borrowed money, not profit.
The projected AI build-out this decade runs all the way into the trillions of dollars.
A large chunk of that is being financed with corporate bonds, which is simply borrowing.
Borrowing to invest is leverage. It magnifies the gains on the way up, and the losses on the way down.
That hidden leverage is the real risk sitting behind all the flashy demos.
Because most of the spend is capex that absolutely must earn its money back.
And we have genuinely seen this movie before, in the dot-com bubble.
That late-nineties boom also ran hot on hype and cheap, borrowed money.
So, looking at the debt instead of the demos, is it a bubble or not?
